title: Prior-only APP Top20 boundary-margin calibration
hypothesis: The standardized score gap between APP SONAR ranks 20 and 21 may contain information about the next target's Top20 hit-count distribution: a larger prior-only boundary margin may correspond to a better calibrated or more concentrated hit-count forecast.

estimand.forecast: For target index t, execute the exact committed sonarAnalogCore on draws[0:t] and obtain its 40 ranked scores.
estimand.boundary_margin: g_t=(score_rank20-score_rank21)/population_sd(all 40 scores); scores are sorted descending, so the numerator is non-negative.
estimand.outcome: H_t = number of target draw numbers contained in the prior-only APP Top20.
estimand.states: LOW if g<=q33; MID if q33<g<=q67; HIGH if g>q67.
estimand.thresholds: q33 and q67 are order statistics at indices floor((199)/3)=66 and floor(2*199/3)=132 of the 200 margin values from calibration target indices 200..399. Thresholds are fixed thereafter; ties are not rebalanced.

models.tuning: No parameter or threshold tuning on Discovery, Validation, or Blind OOS. Quantile thresholds are derived only from the 200 prior-only calibration forecasts and then frozen.

sample.split_rule: 60% / 20% / remainder of the 3,004 scored targets, in chronological order.

inference.method: One-sided paired block sign-flip on per-target loss gains; positive means M2 improves.
inference.bootstrap: Circular moving-block bootstrap, 10,000 replicates, block length 20, percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across four primary endpoints: Brier and log-loss for M2 versus M1 and M2 versus M0.

leakage_controls: Pin canonical archive, APP data, and exact committed scorer blob SHAs.
For every target, compute all 40 scores from draws strictly before that target.
The 200 margin calibration forecasts use no target outcomes to estimate q33/q67.
After calibration, initialize sequential hit-count state only with outcomes whose targets precede the scored target.
Score first, then update global and margin-state counts with the current target outcome.
Mutate target and future suffix at nine fixed targets and verify the current margin and Top20 remain unchanged.
Verify APP modelDraws exactly matches canonical CSV row-by-row.
Replay the complete ledger, report, validation, and prospective freeze deterministically.
guardrails: Research-only; no production scorer, ranking, or existing freeze changes.
Q122 prospective freeze is separate and is not a Q60 pair.
No Q60 gate edits and no reconstructed historical freezes.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
No automatic merge or engine promotion.
decision_rule: Retain M2 only as an exploratory diagnostic if it improves both Brier and log-loss versus M1 and M0 on Blind OOS with Holm-adjusted one-sided tests supporting improvement. Otherwise record a null/negative result. No production promotion.
